mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase above 4.0% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates real discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 550,000 units and $340 billion, respectively, indicate broad demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST < 550.0 and RSAFS < 340000.0, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.2 percentage points signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer confidence and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 7.0% periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 45% of instances with UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 100.5 (2017=100) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 550,000 units indicate weakening residential demand that reduces construction sector activity and corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate decline exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals aggressive policy easing to counter inflation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.0% periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 45% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline > 0.25pp, or Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 50,000 persons signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS increase > 50.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window.
